title: Customer feature requests and preferences
summary: The topic consists of brief statements about customer wants or desired options across app features, parking assistance, key access, and other preferences, without enough context to determine sentiment.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews describe customer-requested features or preferences such as app window control, EA promotion display, automatic PDC activation, item organization, and obtaining an additional key, but do not state whether the customer felt satisfied or dissatisfied.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic reflects requests or stated wants rather than clear evaluative feedback.
The examples mix several unrelated feature and usage requests, so there is limited coherence beyond customers stating preferences.
Some fragments are too brief or incomplete to identify the exact system or context being discussed.
